title: Buffer read at a suffix boundary
statement: For any Boolean words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{bs}$, the buffer tape containing their concatenation, when read at cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$, returns the first bit of $\mathrm{bs}$, or blank if $\mathrm{bs}$ is empty.
replaced: For all binary words $p$ and $s$, reading the buffer tape holding $p\,s$ at cell $|p|$ returns the first bit of $s$, or blank when $s$ is empty.
